title: fix(objectql): withdrawing an extender package restores the owner's bridged object copy, so GET /meta/object/NAME drops the extension field at once
body:
Fixes #24182

Clause-②: no

## What this changes

After `DELETE /api/v1/marketplace/install-local/:manifestId` of a package that extends another package's object, `GET /api/v1/meta/object/NAME` now serves the owner's body without the withdrawn extension's fields at once. The object listing and the data plane already did. A restart is no longer needed.

- `packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts` (the bridge's owner):
  - `bridgeManifestObjectsToMetadataService` now records, for each package it bridges as an EXTENDER, the names of the objects whose copy it rewrote. Those are copies stamped with another package's id (the owner's) and re-registered with the merged body. The record is the new field `extendedObjectCopies`.
  - New `restoreExtendedObjectCopies(ctx, packageId)`, exposed on the `manifest` service beside `register`. Once the registry no longer holds the package, it re-registers each recorded copy with the registry's current definition (`currentObjectCopyBody`, the same shape the bridge writes), through the bridge's own verb (`register(..., { notify: false })`). It adds no second merge.
  - Same rule as the bridge's overwrite: only a copy whose `_packageId` is the registry owner's id is written, so an authored copy stays. A name the registry no longer serves is left to the owner's own withdrawal (PR #24181's half). A package the registry still holds is not withdrawn, and nothing is done.
  - Never rejects. A copy that cannot be written is logged once at `error` with the consequence and the remedy (restart), the level `followRuntimeObjectCopy` uses for the same registry/copy disagreement.
- `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`: **the claim's declared cross-lane edit, the call only.** Right after `withdrawObjectCopies`, and only when the registry withdrew, the DELETE handler calls `manifest.restoreExtendedObjectCopies(manifestId)`. The DELETE answer is unchanged.
- Pins: `packages/objectql/src/plugin.integration.test.ts` (the bridge tests, two cases) and `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-uninstall-meta-reads.test.ts` (beside the #24070 pin, one case through the real DELETE). That file's `install`/`uninstall` helpers now take an optional manifest and id; the existing four cases call them unchanged.
- `.changeset/24182-extender-withdrawal-restores-owner.md`: `patch` for `@objectstack/objectql` and `@objectstack/cloud-connection`.

## The mechanism, measured

- **H1, confirmed.** After `registry.uninstallPackage(EXTENDER)` the registry already serves the owner's body without the extension field. The objectql pin asserts it: `registry.getObject('crm_contact').fields` has no `ext_score`. The stale state is only the owner's metadata-service copy, which the extender's bridge rewrote under the owner's stamp. The counterpart re-puts the registry's current definition, with no second merge.
- **H2, falsified: there is no seam.** The install-local DELETE fires no kernel event: no `ctx.trigger` in the uninstall path, and `metadata:reloaded` is announced only by the hot install. `SchemaRegistry.uninstallPackage` emits nothing. And after the withdrawal the registry no longer says which objects the package extended. So the bridge has to remember what it rewrote, and the door that withdrew the package has to call its counterpart. The call is the one cloud-connection line block named above.
- **H3, read from source, not measured live.** The protocol door `DELETE /packages/:id` (`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`) also calls `registry.uninstallPackage` and does not call the counterpart. It refuses an install-local package with `422 WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED` (measured by PR #24181). A writable package's objects reach the metadata service through `followRuntimeObjectCopy`, not through this bridge, so the record holds nothing for it. Package disable of an extender was not measured. Both are in Acceptance notes, not widened into this PR.
- **H4, the live re-measure** is below: the card's setup reproduces on the base, and the head fixes it.

## The public door, before and after (live)

Setup: `pnpm dev:crm -- --fresh -p PORT` from this worktree with `OS_CLOUD_URL=off` (the real `MetadataPlugin` and `MarketplaceInstallLocal`), signed in as the seeded dev admin. Package A `com.example.crmlite` (objects `crmlite_account`, `crmlite_contact`) and package B `com.example.crmliteext` (only an `objectExtensions` field `ext_score` on `crmlite_account`) are installed inline through install-local. Then B is DELETEd.

- **Base** (`packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts` and the install-local plugin restored in the tree to `bb7ccde66`'s blobs, both packages rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight --absent` on `restoreExtendedObjectCopies` exit 0 for both):
  - before the DELETE, `GET /meta/object/crmlite_account` is `200` with `ext_score` and `name`;
  - `DELETE` answers `200`, `cleanups: [security.package-permissions: success]`;
  - after it, `GET /meta/object/crmlite_account` is **`200` with `ext_score`**. `GET /meta/object` lists `crmlite_account` without `ext_score`, and `GET /data/crmlite_account?fields=ext_score` answers `400`. This is the card's reading.
- **Head** (rebuilt, preflight marker present in both `dist/`), the same sequence:
  - after the DELETE, `GET /meta/object/crmlite_account` is `200` **without `ext_score`**, `name` kept, `_packageId: com.example.crmlite`;
  - the listing and the data plane read as on the base, and the DELETE answer is byte-identical.
- One deviation from the card's setup: `os dev` (through `pnpm dev:crm`), not `os start`. Both arm the late bridge this fix lives in.
- The probe script lived in the session scratchpad. Each server was stopped by its recorded process group, and the tree was restored to HEAD (`git diff HEAD` empty) before anything else.

## Gates (after the final commit, `3a452eeae`)

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths) derived 67 commands. All 67 exit 0, each code captured before any pipe.
  - On the first pass, `check:slot-lookup` was red: this PR's objectql pin added two untyped `getService` lookups (23 to 25). They are typed now (`IMetadataService`, `ObjectQL`). The ratchet holds at 101 unswept, none new.
  - `check-engine-split-ratio --days 90` (exit 2) and `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (exit 3) refused on the shallow clone. After `git fetch --shallow-since=2026-07-12 origin main`, both exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`: "67 derived, 67 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN", a derived zero (all 67 carry an exit code).
- Not run locally and declared to CI: `test:repo`, the CLI `integration` tier (no spawn entry touched), the type-check lanes beyond the two packages' own `typecheck`, the dogfood shards and the repo-wide `pnpm lint`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Read-only inference, not measured.** A hot upgrade of an extender whose new version DROPS an extension re-bridges only the objects the new version still contributes to. The owner's copy would keep the dropped field until the extender is uninstalled (the record keeps the name, so this counterpart then restores it) or the runtime restarts. That is the same family on another door. Not fixed here.
- **Read-only inference, not measured (H3).** `DELETE /packages/:id` withdraws through the same registry verb without calling this counterpart. Today no bridged extender reaches it: install-local packages are refused there, and writable packages are not bridged by this path. Package disable of an extender was not measured.
- The record is per process. A copy rewritten by the boot-time one-shot bridge is not recorded. Every install-local package (hot install and ledger rehydrate) registers after `start()` has armed the late bridge, so its rewrites are recorded. A boot-time code package is not withdrawn by this door.
